items.prompt: Shapes (3, 1) and (3,) are added elementwise under NumPy broadcasting. What is the result shape?

options.why: The trailing dimensions align as 1 and 3, and the leading dimension remains 3.
Broadcasting expands the singleton dimension rather than matching three pairs.

options.text: An error for every possible input value
options.why: These sizes are compatible under the broadcasting rules.

items.explanation: The rightmost dimensions 1 and 3 expand to 3, while the missing leading dimension of (3,) behaves as 1 and expands to 3.
